#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fig 3: NVE Diagnostic — Task B2 CIVO detection (D054 corrected).
008e_v3_s2 reclassified as non-CIVO (IRD), shown as FP.
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

# --- Data: Task B2 (>=1.5x @ 35K+) ---
# True CIVO-positive
tp = [
    ('006',          4.84),
    ('008d',         4.13),
    ('009b',         1.62),
]
# True negatives
tn = [
    ('001',          1.00),
    ('008a',         0.93),
    ('008f',         0.97),
    ('008e_v3_s1',   0.94),
]
# False positive (D054: reclassified as non-CIVO / IRD)
fp = [
    ('008e_v3_s2',   3.78),
]

THRESHOLD = 1.5

all_points = []
for name, nve in tn:
    all_points.append((name, nve, 'TN'))
for name, nve in fp:
    all_points.append((name, nve, 'FP'))
for name, nve in tp:
    all_points.append((name, nve, 'TP'))

all_points.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])

labels = [p[0] for p in all_points]
nves   = [p[1] for p in all_points]
types  = [p[2] for p in all_points]
y_pos  = np.arange(len(all_points))

COLOR_TP = '#C0392B'  # red
COLOR_TN = '#2471A3'  # blue
COLOR_FP = '#E67E22'  # orange

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4.2))

# threshold band
ax.axvspan(0, THRESHOLD, alpha=0.06, color=COLOR_TN, zorder=0)
ax.axvspan(THRESHOLD, 6, alpha=0.06, color=COLOR_TP, zorder=0)
ax.axvline(x=THRESHOLD, color='#7F8C8D', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2,
           zorder=1, label=f'Threshold = {THRESHOLD}x')

for i, (name, nve, tp_type) in enumerate(all_points):
    if tp_type == 'TP':
        color = COLOR_TP
        marker = 'o'
        ms = 9
        zorder = 3
    elif tp_type == 'FP':
        color = COLOR_FP
        marker = 'D'
        ms = 9
        zorder = 4
    else:
        color = COLOR_TN
        marker = 's'
        ms = 8
        zorder = 3

    ax.plot(nve, i, marker=marker, color=color, markersize=ms,
            markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.2, zorder=zorder)
    ax.plot([0, nve], [i, i], color=color, linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.4, zorder=2)

    # FP annotation
    if tp_type == 'FP':
        ax.annotate('FP (IRD,\nnon-CIVO)',
                     xy=(nve, i), xytext=(nve + 0.35, i + 0.5),
                     fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=COLOR_FP,
                     arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=COLOR_FP,
                                     lw=1.2, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.2'),
                     zorder=5)

ax.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax.set_yticklabels(labels, fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlabel('Normalized Value Excess (NVE)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_xlim(-0.1, 5.6)
ax.set_ylim(-0.6, len(all_points) - 0.3)

# region labels
ax.text(THRESHOLD / 2, len(all_points) - 0.55, 'Non-CIVO\nregion',
        ha='center', va='top', fontsize=9, color=COLOR_TN, alpha=0.7)
ax.text(THRESHOLD + (5.6 - THRESHOLD) / 2, len(all_points) - 0.55,
        'CIVO-positive\nregion',
        ha='center', va='top', fontsize=9, color=COLOR_TP, alpha=0.7)

# legend
h_tp = plt.Line2D([], [], marker='o', color=COLOR_TP, markersize=8,
                   markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1, linestyle='None',
                   label='True CIVO (TP)')
h_tn = plt.Line2D([], [], marker='s', color=COLOR_TN, markersize=7,
                   markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1, linestyle='None',
                   label='Non-CIVO (TN)')
h_fp = plt.Line2D([], [], marker='D', color=COLOR_FP, markersize=8,
                   markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1, linestyle='None',
                   label='False Positive')
h_th = plt.Line2D([], [], color='#7F8C8D', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2,
                   label=f'Threshold ({THRESHOLD}x)')
ax.legend(handles=[h_tp, h_tn, h_fp, h_th], loc='lower right',
          fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9)

# stats box
stats_text = (
    f'AUROC = 0.933\n'
    f'Accuracy = 7/8 (87.5%)\n'
    f'Task B2: NVE $\\geq$ {THRESHOLD}x @ 35K+'
)
ax.text(0.98, 0.02, stats_text, transform=ax.transAxes,
        ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9.5,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor='#FAFAFA',
                  edgecolor='#BDC3C7', alpha=0.95))

ax.set_title('NVE Diagnostic: CIVO Detection (D054 Corrected)', fontsize=13,
             fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.15, axis='x', zorder=0)

plt.tight_layout()

outdir = '/root/autodl-tmp/event-gated-adaptive-horizon/artifacts'
import os
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
plt.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig3_nve_diagnostic_d054.pdf')
plt.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig3_nve_diagnostic_d054.png')
plt.close()
print(f'Saved: {outdir}/fig3_nve_diagnostic_d054.pdf')
print(f'Saved: {outdir}/fig3_nve_diagnostic_d054.png')
